description: Source-to-sink reachability over the per-function call graph (1.6+). Surfaces "this function reads `process.env`/`req.body` and calls `exec`/`eval`/raw SQL" patterns. Defaults cover common JS / Python sources + sinks; project-specific names go in `.projscanrc.json` `taint`.

max_flows.description: Cap the number of flows returned (most-direct first; same-function flows lead). Default 50.

sinks.description: Additional sink names to merge with the defaults. Useful for project-specific dangerous wrappers like `runRawSql` or `dangerouslyEval`.

sources.description: Additional source names to merge with the defaults. Match is by bare name (rightmost identifier), so `customSecretReader()` adds the literal "customSecretReader".

name: projscan_taint
